tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE complete full-body visual-novel expression sprite of Klee wearing Blossoming Starlight.
Use ONLY the supplied user-approved Blossoming Starlight neutral as the image reference. Independently create this new expression directly from that neutral; preserve her identity, face, bright red irises, blonde side pigtails, pointed ears, light skin, compact childlike Small Female build, and the approved neutral's cute proportions and polished 2D anime rendering. Keep her at least as petite as the reference, with a relatively large head, short torso and short legs, without elongation. Change face, pose and gesture to clearly communicate the requested acting.
Preserve the reference's complete outfit and accessories: oversized pointed red witch hat, dark-edged brim and cream lining, striped red bow and gold Pyro ornament, hair ribbon and clover, red neck bow, white puff-sleeve blouse, dark ruffled vest, red buckled waistband, diagonal brown strap, red skirt and white apron with clover-flower trim, red side bows, dark and white hem ruffles, dark brown gloves with flared cuffs, white patterned stockings with clover cuffs and red bows, and dark Mary Jane shoes with clover fasteners. Keep clothing natural and fully covering her as in the reference.
ACTING: Playfully smug after pulling off a harmless surprise: a clearly readable cheeky closed grin with one corner lifted, one eyebrow raised and both red eyes open with normal pupils. Her chin tips up slightly; her right gloved hand rests on her hip, while her left forearm bends with a small loose fist held beside her chest as if proudly saying 'Hehe, Klee did it!' Shoulders relaxed, slight sideways body angle, both feet planted apart. Keep it mischievous and childlike.
CONSTRUCTION: Simple readable gestures close to the body and close to the image plane. Each hand has a palm, four naturally articulated fingers and a separate opposable thumb, with glove shapes clear and distinct from clothing. No tangled or clasped hands, extreme foreshortening or exaggerated finger splaying. Exactly two legs and two feet belonging to one pelvis, feet separated or only slightly staggered. One coherent mouth with a simple lip shape. Preserve normal pupils in both eyes.
OUTPUT: One character only, full silhouette including all hat tips, brim, hair, hands, skirt, stockings and shoes. Roughly 92-96% visible height with 2-4% top and bottom padding. Genuine transparent background. Match the reference's clean linework, rich colors and soft cel shading. No scenery, labels, text, UI, watermark, floating effects, handheld props or ground shadow.
